High tides this evening and both morning and evening high tides on Monday may lead to flooding. Flooding is possible from 06:50pm to 10:50pm on the 25/10/2026. Flooding is also possible from 07:11am to 11:11am and 07:30pm to 11:30pm on the 26/10/2026. Areas most at risk include Christchurch Harbour and tidal stretches of the Lower Stour and Avon. The detailed tidal forecast for those who use it is - the first forecast high water of 1.22mAODN is at 08:50pm, with westerly force 5 winds. The second forecast high water is at 09:11am on the 26 October with a level of 1.38mAODN with southerly force 6 winds. The third forecast high water is at 09:30pm with a level of 1.36mAODN with south westerly force 6 winds. (mAODN is height above average sea level.). We are closely monitoring the situation. Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded. Don't put yourself or others at risk. This message will be updated by 02:00PM on Monday 26 October or as the situation changes.

High tides on Sunday may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible for 2 hours either side of Sunday evening's tide at 22:30 on 25/10/2026.
The weather increases tide table values by 0.48 m. Total forecast tide is 6.27 metres Chart Datum (3.22 mAOD) at Littlehampton. Strong Westerly Force 6 wind. 
Waves could cause overtopping of the beach, affecting Climping Street Car Park. A small amount of water may flow or be directed westwards along Mill Lane towards residential property in Climping Street. Monday morning’s tide at 11:00 on 26/10/2026 is forecast to be 15cm higher.
A little water may affect Climping Street on Monday morning.
Monday evening’s tide at 23:00 will be lower, but minor flood impacts could be possible.
We are closely monitoring the situation . We routinely check the condition of the beach at Climping.
Consider activating any flood protection products you may have. Access could be restricted. Take care if visiting Climping beach.
This message will be updated by 6:00PM on Monday 26 October or as the situation changes.

High tides, strong winds and large waves tomorrow may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible 2 hours either side of high tide on Monday morning and Monday evening. 
The high tide at Exmouth on Monday morning is at 06:24, times of high water will vary along the coast.  Forecast total high tide level is 2.43mAOD, which is 0.4 metres above tide table level.  

Strong force 6 Southerly winds and offshore wave heights of over 1m are forecast over the high tide.

High tide on Monday evening is at 18:44.  Forecast total high tide level is 2.54mAOD, which is 0.42 metres above tide table level. 

Strong force 6 South Westerly winds and offshore wave heights of over 1.5m are forecast.

Coastal conditions should ease for Tuesday morning's high tide. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded.   
This message will be updated by 12:00PM on Tuesday 27 October or as the situation changes.
